name: Ex Works
responsibility_transfer: Seller's premises; buyer bears all transport risk/cost from there

name: Free Carrier
responsibility_transfer: Seller delivers to carrier named by buyer at seller's premises or another named place

name: Carriage Paid To
responsibility_transfer: Seller pays carriage to destination; risk transfers on handover to first carrier

name: Carriage and Insurance Paid To
responsibility_transfer: As CPT, plus seller arranges insurance to destination

name: Delivered at Place
responsibility_transfer: Seller bears risk/cost until goods ready for unloading at named destination

name: Delivered at Place Unloaded
responsibility_transfer: As DAP, but seller also unloads at destination

name: Delivered Duty Paid
responsibility_transfer: Seller bears all risk/cost including import duty to named destination

name: Free Alongside Ship
responsibility_transfer: Seller delivers alongside the vessel at named port; sea/waterway only

name: Free on Board
responsibility_transfer: Seller delivers on board the vessel; risk transfers at ship's rail; sea/waterway only

name: Cost and Freight
responsibility_transfer: Seller pays freight to destination port; risk transfers on board; sea/waterway only

name: Cost, Insurance and Freight
responsibility_transfer: As CFR, plus seller arranges insurance; sea/waterway only
